en: A sepia-toned panoramic photograph showing a rural, hilly landscape dotted with houses, hotels, and small buildings. There is a prominent building in the foreground, labeled as 'Hotel Meiningerhof.' The image shows cultivated fields, a road, and more buildings scattered across green hills. The style of architecture and the open landscape suggest a European rural area. There is handwritten text on the lower left of the postcard.
